correctness.rationale: Differentiating G gives lambda=k Psi(sd), strictly monotone from zero to infinity; solving the unique neutral equation via Lambert W yields the stated branch choice. Negative Schwarzian implies a unique derivative-above-one interval on the rising branch; together with G(0)=0, G(1/2)=1 and the positive neutral quadratic B=1/a−3+exp(−sd), this gives exactly 3/2 fixed points. Reciprocal-increment telescope for G(x)=x+(B/2)x²+O(x³) yields Nδ=2/(Bx)+O(log 1/x) at fixed parameters, and 2^n full monotone laps imply htop=log2. The extension s=0 is explicitly separated from the original source domain.

evidence: Classical lap entropy proves log2 for full branches, not local bifurcation classification; flat-critical large deviations assume different critical behavior.
